name: Tart cherry
short: In a 28-day trial in 50 people with gout, only 1 of 24 adverse events (high blood sugar) was judged possibly related. In a knee osteoarthritis trial, withdrawals were similar to placebo.
text: In a 28-day randomised trial of tart cherry juice concentrate in 50 people with gout, 24 adverse events were reported, of which only one (hyperglycaemia) was considered possibly related to the cherry concentrate. In a randomised double-blind crossover trial of tart cherry juice in 58 non-diabetic patients with knee osteoarthritis, there were five withdrawals during the cherry juice period (four due to adverse events) and seven during the placebo period (three due to adverse events). No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
